hooks.command: input=$(cat); s=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); f=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] && echo "$f" >> "/tmp/claude-session-edits-${s}-$(date +%Y%m%d).txt"; true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(pnpm-lock\.yaml|\.env)' && echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit lock files or .env files' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
